answer: Each agent must cultivate a violet vine on the ledge: the beacon emits a growth seed each epoch, and the agent must root a unique tendril. The first shoot costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent tendril doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at tendril 14 (20.4 M iterations). A ledge audit verifies each root against the epoch seed; any withered vine voids the climb. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full ledge cost because each tendril binds to the unique identity key—no shared roots possible.
